verdict.rationale: Martin's docs describe multiple autonomous background automations—daily/weekly briefings, proactive email drafting, email triage/labeling with follow-up actions, wake-up calls, and cc-to-schedule meeting booking—plus shortcuts for multi-step triggers, all running without direct user prompting. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of Martin as a persistent background agent (todo management alongside coding) and acknowledges past reliability concerns that have since improved. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of background task reliability at scale and more detail on failure/error handling for autonomous actions.
